# tomswallapi Provider

Manage a tomswallapi firewall control plane: fleet-global zones, address groups, portgroups, rules, policies, and fabrics, plus per-device zone->interface bindings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    tomswallapi = {
      source = "IUCLabs/tomswallapi"
    }
  }
}

# The token defaults to the TOMSWALLAPI_WRITE_TOKEN environment variable.
provider "tomswallapi" {
  endpoint = "https://tomswallapi.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint` (String) The tomswallapi base URL (e.g. https://tomswallapi.example.com).

### Optional

- `token` (String, Sensitive) Write token (bearer) for mutating operations. Defaults to the TOMSWALLAPI_WRITE_TOKEN environment variable.
